svg.aria-label: Smart glasses privacy: default settings to change and where the glasses are banned

g.text: The privacy reality in 2026: what's on by default, and where you can't wear them
Meta AI glasses — defaults to change on day one
1. "Hey Meta" wake word
Keeps the mics — and camera-for-AI — always ready. Turn it off
in the Meta AI app if you want button-only capture.
2. Voice recordings
Stored by default, up to a year, no opt-out per Meta's 2025 policy.
Deletable manually in the app's voice-history settings.
3. Photos, video and audio used to train Meta AI
Camera captures used with Meta AI feed the training pipeline by default.
Review "Meta AI with camera" and data-sharing toggles in Settings → Privacy.
4. Human review
A 2026 lawsuit alleges contractors reviewed intimate footage. Assume
anything you send to the AI can be seen by a person.
5. The LED
Recording lights the front LED; it's small and easy to miss in daylight.
Tell people. Ask first indoors. Don't record where you'd need consent.
Rokid (ChatGPT/Gemini), Even Realities and Android XR glasses have their own
policies; Even's G2 sidesteps most of this by having no camera at all.
Where camera glasses are banned (a growing list)
• Courts: New York banned camera/mic eyewear statewide in all
Unified Court System facilities (July 20, 2026); federal courts list them
as prohibited items.
• Cinemas and theatres — anti-piracy policies, US and UK chains.
• Gyms, spas, locker rooms, pools, cruise ships, casinos.
• Schools and exam halls — after the Korean "AI glasses solved the
college entrance exam" video, exam boards worldwide moved to ban them.
• Hospitals and clinics, workplaces with recording policies.
• Military bases, secure facilities, DEF CON 34 (no exceptions,
including prescription versions).
• EU: the AI Act's ban on real-time remote biometric identification
in public applied from August 2, 2026 — facial recognition on glasses
is off the table there.
Trackers counted 47+ venues and jurisdictions with explicit bans by mid-2026,
up from a handful in 2024. Expect a "please remove your glasses" moment.
Camera-free alternatives:
Even Realities G2, Amazon Echo Frames, Xreal/Viture XR glasses.

svg.text: Sources: Meta privacy policy updates (2025), TechCrunch, Incogni, Glasses Radar ban tracker, NY OCA notice, MBC/Korean press on exam cheating. Check the current policy before relying on any default.
